## APP_LOCALES

Supporting declaration used by a public type. This is not an additional runtime API or SDK helper.

```ts
declare const APP_LOCALES: readonly [
    "en",
    "zh-CN"
];
```

## AppLocale

Public SDK type, exported as `AppLocale`. Import with `import type`; the SDK has no runtime exports.

One shipped locale.

```ts
export type AppLocale = (typeof APP_LOCALES)[number];
```

**Related types:** [APP_LOCALES](i18n-locales.md#app_locales).
